script_text: Something quiet is about to crack open in your career, Pisces. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun rides late Scorpio in your 9th House, while Venus in Scorpio trines Jupiter in Cancer, lighting your 5th House — Tuesday is magnetic for love, so say yes. Neptune, your ruling planet, sits in Aries in your 2nd House, and water signs over-give; keep money off Monday's table. Wednesday is the turning point: Mercury enters Sagittarius and your 10th House, giving your quiet work a voice. Thursday through Sunday the Sun follows Mercury into Sagittarius, putting your name forward: pitch, apply, ask. Uranus in Gemini sextiles Neptune in Aries, stirring your 4th House; expect a home surprise Saturday. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury enters your 10th House. Monday is your weakest day, with Neptune fogging your 2nd House. Settle every bill before you daydream. Follow for daily updates.
